requirements: Use advanced connector policies as a default-deny allowlist.
Retain classic DLP mixed mode for HTTP and custom connectors.
Allow fixed approved HTTP host/path patterns, then deny all others.
Do not rely on endpoint filtering for dynamically supplied endpoints.
Enforce reader/writer separation in target-system ACLs because DLP does not distinguish two references to the same connector.
Power Platform DLP does not extend into Cowork prompts.
